name: Cold
target_source: Moon target value: LRO Diviner temperature maps

name: Aridity
earth_source: NASA POWER climatology (precipitation) [supporting]; EMIT arid-region coverage

name: Barren ground
earth_source: EMIT L2B (bare mineral surface); HLSL30 reflectance/NDVI for zoom on top candidates

name: Terrain roughness
earth_source: NASA SRTMGL30 (~1 km) and NSIDC-0422 Antarctic 1 km DEM: relief within the cell [coarse]
target_source: Moon: LOLA DEM; Mars: MOLA via Mars Trek

name: Rock / regolith composition
description: Mafic (silica-poor, basalt-like) character of bare ground; thermal-emissivity proxy. Not rock exposure, not mineral identification.
earth_source: NASA ASTER Global Emissivity Dataset v4.1 (silicate contrast, bare ground only) [proxy]

name: Ice / permafrost
earth_source: MODIS MOD10CM snow cover, 2015-2024 monthly climatology [proxy: not glacier, permafrost or subsurface ice]
target_source: Moon: Diviner polar cold-trap maps; Mars: SWIM/SHARAD (literature)

name: Seasonal light extremes
description: Large seasonal swing in daylight (polar illumination regime)
